rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that cannot be imagined or conceived.

example.english: I find it unimaginable that he could accomplish such a big task alone.
example.traditional: 我真係想像唔到佢可以一個人完成咁大件事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 zoeng6 m4 dou2 keoi5 ho2 ji5 jat1 go3 jan4 jyun4 sing4 gam3 daai6 gin6 si6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that an event or claim is so extraordinary that it is hard to believe, rather than literally impossible to imagine.

example.english: It is unimaginable that he made so much money in just one hour.
example.traditional: 佢一個鐘頭就賺到咁多錢，真係難以置信。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 go3 zung1 tau4 zau6 zaan6 dou3 gam3 do1 cin4 zan1 hai6 naan4 ji5 zi3 seon3
